name: FaceGate — Enterprise Biometric Attendance & CCTV Recognition
summary: High-throughput automated attendance & access control engine utilizing multi-camera RTSP surveillance feeds. Delivers sub-280ms inference across thousands of registered identities with 99.82% top-1 verification accuracy, dynamic anti-spoofing liveness filters, and automated attendance state-machines.
detail: Monorepo architecture featuring an asynchronous FastAPI Python microservice running TensorRT/ONNX-accelerated face detection and 512-dimensional facial embedding extraction. Employs pgvector cosine index search in PostgreSQL for millisecond matching against large employee rosters. Frontends include a real-time reactive Vite/React operations console and an Expo React Native mobile scanner with offline cryptographic sync.
architecture:
RTSP Multi-Stream ──> GStreamer/FFmpeg ──> YOLOv8 Face Align ──> 512D ArcFace Feature Net
                                                                          │
PostgreSQL pgvector <── REST / SSE Event Bus <── Cosine Nearest Neighbor <┘
        │
        └──> React Vite Live Console (WebSockets) + Expo Mobile App

name: EProcMon — Autonomous BUMN Tender Intelligence & Scraper Engine
summary: 24/7 high-resilience autonomous monitoring platform scraping over 150+ Indonesian BUMN, LPSE, and SPSE procurement portals. Implements adaptive DOM parsers, automatic session rotation, and keyword classification pipelines to alert bidding teams in real-time.
detail: Engineered as an ultra-low-overhead monorepo powered by Bun runtime and Elysia.js. Scheduled distributed scraper workers cycle through multi-source government endpoints, normalizing disparate HTML payloads into structured JSON entities. Real-time updates dispatch via Supabase CDC (Change Data Capture) WebSockets to a reactive SvelteKit analytical dashboard and instant Discord webhook webhooks with priority filtering.
architecture:
150+ LPSE/SPSE Portals ──> Distributed Bun Headless Workers ──> Normalizer & Classifier
                                                                      │
Discord Webhooks <── Realtime SSE Pipeline <── Supabase Postgres DB <┘
                                                      │
                                         SvelteKit Analytical GUI

name: Lunaria AI — Autonomous Multi-Agent Personality & Tool Engine
summary: Interactive autonomous assistant framework uniting persistent identity memory, deterministic tool-calling schemas, and SSE streaming token generation. Powers operator workflows and user-facing interactive conversational shims.
detail: Built atop modern LLM runtime architectures with structured JSON function calling, context compression buffers, and automated session state tracking. Includes custom prompt injection protections and dynamic domain knowledge retrieval.
architecture:
User Message / Prompt ──> Tokenizer / Context Window ──> LLM Completion Stream
                                     │                             │
                          Function Tool Execution ◄────────────────┘
                                     │
                       SSE Stream Response to UI

name: EZVIZ RTSP Telemetry & Camera Automation Suite
summary: Cross-platform desktop application and hardware control suite for remote EZVIZ surveillance cameras. Supports multi-stream RTSP decoding, pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) velocity control, IR-night mode switching, local cryptographic session caching, and alarm event webhooks.
detail: Eliminates proprietary vendor cloud lock-in by executing direct encrypted socket and HTTP API sessions against EZVIZ device endpoints. Combines OpenCV frame acquisition with CustomTkinter hardware acceleration for rock-solid stability in production factory monitoring.
architecture:
Hardware Camera ──> RTSP Video Feed ──> OpenCV Frame Processor ──> Desktop Canvas GUI
        │
Device API Session ──> pyezvizapi Encrypted Channel ──> Pan/Tilt/Zoom Controller

name: Industrial Sugar Manufacturing Procurement Suite
summary: Mission-critical analytical dashboard suite deployed for industrial sugar factory operations. Consolidates disparate sugarcane supply chain intakes, procurement logistics, yield analytics, and multi-tier operational telemetry into interactive dashboards.
detail: Architected with Vue 3 Composition API, Vite, and high-performance charting primitives backed by Node.js Express and PostgreSQL. Features automated export engines (PNG vector rendering and multi-tier CSV/Excel pipelines), custom report builders, and strict role-based access control.
architecture:
Factory Logistics DB ──> Node.js Express ORM ──> Aggregation & Cache Layer
                                                         │
Vector PDF / CSV Exporter ◄── Vue 3 Analytical Dashboard ◄┘
